title: Rezolute FDA Review Continues After Phase 3 sunRIZE Study Missed Primary Endpoint
summary: Rezolute (NASDAQ:RZLT) said the FDA is continuing its review of additional Phase 3 sunRIZE data for ersodetug in congenital hyperinsulinism after the study failed to meet its primary endpoint, leaving the potential regulatory path unresolved and without a specific timeline for agency feedback. Key Investor TakeawaysThe FDA review remains ongoing as the agency evaluates whether there is a potential regulatory path forward for ersodetug in congenital hyperinsulinism.
